{{Quote|At the Flesh Raider command base, I found coordinates to a number of secret camps&mdash;too many to send only Jedi Masters. One base is in the ruins of Upper Kaleth. That patrol you fought earlier was based there. Now's your chance to finish them off.|Orgus Din|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Forsaken Den''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] within the ruins of<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]] temple-[[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi" /> of [[Kaleth]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The cave contained the ruins of a meditation shrine, and it was used as a base by the native [[Flesh Raider]]s during their [[Flesh Raider uprising|uprising]]<ref name="TOR" /> in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|1}}</ref> During the uprising, a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Laotah]] tried to investigate activity in the area, but was mortally wounded by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] natives in the cave. However, the [[Hero of Tython|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] was sent to eliminate the base, and [[Raid on the Forsaken Den|defeated]] the Flesh Raiders within.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Forsaken Den appears in the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a class-restricted story phase for the Jedi Knight mission "Dark Temptations."<ref name="TOR" />
